title: Radio Stations (the old valve radio)
layout_order: title bar Radio Stations (close, minimise, resize) | walnut cabinet: cloth grille with the magic eye and its ON AIR / OFF AIR plate (left), dial glass with kHz figures, LW / MW / SW bands printed with the genres, red needle, station name and detail (right) | genre keys in 2-4 rows (Wolf, Residents, every genre) | station log card: heading STATION LOG - <genre>, Add your station... at its right, Station / Country / kbps list | bottom strip: Volume knob (left), Listen / Set on land / Add to my presets over the maker's plate status line (centre), Tuning knob (right)

controls.name: floater
controls.label: Radio Stations window: closable, minimisable, resizable (min 540 x 540), remembers its place; the whole radio relays out on every resize

controls.name: on-open
controls.label: opening loads the station lists and says Tuning in: loading the stations... (or why they cannot load)
source: st.load(); refreshGenres(); if (st.isLoading()) setStatus("Tuning in: loading the stations...");

controls.name: not-wolf
controls.label: The radio stations are for Wolf Territories. (status, red) off a Wolf login
source: mLastError = "The radio stations are for Wolf Territories.";
std::string("The station list could not be loaded (")

controls.name: on-close
controls.label: closing stops the private preview and gives the land's music back

controls.name: magic-eye
controls.label: green magic eye (opens while listening) and its plate ON AIR / OFF AIR
controls.tip: Tuning eye: on air. You are listening to the station on the dial (only you hear it). / Tuning eye: off air. Press Listen, or double-click a station, to hear it.
source: Tuning eye: on air. You are listening to the station on the dial (only you hear it).
Tuning eye: off air. Press Listen, or double-click a station, to hear it.

controls.name: dial
controls.label: dial glass: kHz figures 550-1500, LW / MW / SW bands printed with the genre names (current one red), red needle gliding to the genre's slot then the station in it; station name (with a note sign when on air) and detail genre - country - kbps; idle: WOLF RADIO / Pick a genre, then a station.
source: <floater.string name="idle_detail">Pick a genre, then a station.</floater.string>

controls.label: Wolf
controls.tip: The Wolf Territories stations: WTGR first, then stations run by our residents
source: The Wolf Territories stations: WTGR first, then stations run by our residents

controls.label: Residents
controls.when: lists loaded and the feed has the residents' list
controls.tip: Every station run by a Wolf Territories resident that is on air now
controls.action: WolfFloaterRadio::showGenre(index): the residents' list; saves WolfRadioGenre=wolf; empty list shows the residents_empty comment
source: Every station run by a Wolf Territories resident that is on air now
No resident stations are on air just now. Run an internet radio station? Press "Add your station..." above to put it on this radio.

controls.label: <genre name> (one key per genre in the feed, 14 now)
controls.action: WolfFloaterRadio::showGenre(index): that genre's stations; saves WolfRadioGenre=<genre id>; the last genre is reopened next time

controls.name: genre-key-layout
controls.label: keys wrap onto 2-4 rows, never narrower than 56 px until the 4th row; key height 24-32 px

controls.name: card-title
controls.label: STATION LOG - <genre> heading on the station log card
station log list: Station / Country / kbps (arrow keys move, click picks)
controls.tip: Double-click a station to listen to it
controls.action: click: onSelectStation() (enables the buttons, plays it if listening, updates the dial); double-click: Listen on + onListen()
source: tool_tip="Double-click a station to listen to it"

controls.label: Add your station...
controls.tip: Run an internet radio station? Add it to this radio at wolf-grid.com/wolf-stations (opens your web browser; sign in with your Wolf Territories name). It is listed once it passes the checks, and shows here within the hour, from your next login.
source: tool_tip="Run an internet radio station? Add it to this radio at wolf-grid.com/wolf-stations (opens your web browser; sign in with your Wolf Territories name). It is listed once it passes the checks, and shows here within the hour, from your next login."

Opening wolf-grid.com/wolf-stations in your web browser. Sign in there with your Wolf Territories name; your station is listed once it passes the checks, and shows on this radio within the hour, from your next login.

controls.label: Volume knob (bakelite, turns -135..+135 degrees; label Volume)
controls.tip: Volume: [PERCENT]%. Click the right side or roll the wheel up to turn it up, the left side or wheel down to turn it down. This is the viewer's music volume. (+ Music is muted in the viewer's sound settings. when muted)
source: Volume: [PERCENT]%. Click the right side or roll the wheel up to turn it up, the left side or wheel down to turn it down. This is the viewer's music volume.
Music is muted in the viewer's sound settings.

controls.label: Tuning knob (label Tuning)
controls.tip: Tuning: click the right side or roll the wheel up for the next station in the log, the left side or wheel down for the previous one.
source: Tuning: click the right side or roll the wheel up for the next station in the log, the left side or wheel down for the previous one.

controls.name: knob-input
controls.label: right half of a knob turns it clockwise, left half back; double-click counts as a click; wheel up = clockwise; hand cursor over a knob; sticky tooltips
source: bool handleDoubleClick(S32 x, S32 y, MASK mask) override { return turnAt(x, y); }

controls.label: Listen / Stop
controls.tip: Listen to the station yourself (only you hear it). Press again to stop and get the land's music back.
source: tool_tip="Listen to the station yourself (only you hear it). Press again to stop and get the land's music back."
setStatus("Listening (only you hear this). Press Stop to get the land's music back.");
setStatus("Stopped. The land's own music is back.");

source: tool_tip="Make this station the music on this land, for everyone here"
setStatus("You can't change the music on this land.", true);
setStatus("Only someone who may change this land's media can set its music.");
